mapper.sql: id, world_code as worldCode, world_name as worldName, subtitle, city_code as cityCode, cover_url as coverUrl, intro, status, deleted, sort_no as sortNo, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime
mapper.select: select from ip_world where status = '0' and deleted = '0' and city_code = #{cityCode} order by sort_no asc, id desc

select from ip_world
and world_name like concat('%', #{worldName}, '%') and city_code = #{cityCode} and status = #{status} and deleted = '0'
order by sort_no asc, id desc
mapper.insert: insert into ip_world (world_code, world_name, subtitle, city_code, cover_url, intro, status, deleted, sort_no, create_time) values (#{worldCode}, #{worldName}, #{subtitle}, #{cityCode}, #{coverUrl}, #{intro}, #{status}, #{deleted}, #{sortNo}, #{createTime})
